Runs that errored (failed, or cancelled by the system part-way; stops by you or the host do not count) are grouped by reason, so one cause across several models is one item. An item is listed at 5% or more of the related runs or when it doubled, and marked red at 10% or more or when it doubled. Items state what happened and do not judge which model is better. Expand one to see the runs and jump to the message in its room.

只看主持人派过活、已经结束的任务链，按主持人模型、程序版本、主持人提示词和主持技: Only finished task chains in which the host dispatched work, grouped by host model, app version, host prompt and host skills, so you can compare before and after changing the prompt or skills, or upgrading. Voided dispatches: withdrawn by the host, or stopped, retracted or rolled back by you. Wasted tokens: tokens spent on voided, failed and otherwise cancelled runs. Chains you stepped into: you stopped, retracted or rolled back a run the host dispatched, redirected the host's work, or the chain ended with an unhandled failure; redirects are counted only where they can be recognised, so the real number may be higher. Under 20 chains only counts are shown. Missed dispatches, such as work that should have run in parallel or gone to someone, cannot be seen.
